title: Outbound contact provider composition boundary
purpose: Compose an already-validated outbound contact runtime configuration into the canonical private contact provider composition without reading runtime environment directly, mutating the private route, or executing contact.
requirements: Map the validated telnyx configuration fields apiKey, connectionId, and fromNumber directly into the existing adapter.
Accept transport as an injected dependency so focused tests can use a fake transport and perform no live network request.
Do not read cloudflare:workers, process.env, import.meta.env, or browser input in the composition module.
Do not call requestContact in INS-007V.
Do not duplicate CRM persistence or orchestration construction; continue using the INS-007T seam.
tests: Validated telnyx configuration produces a provider-neutral private composition.
Provider behavior can be exercised only through an injected fake transport.
Composition source contains no runtime-environment reads and no private-route coupling.
boundaries: No live call, SMS, or email.
No provider account activation or configuration.
No routing, scoring, automatic producer assignment, second CRM, or Sesh changes.
nextBoundary: A later explicitly authorized slice may resolve server runtime environment and supply this composition to the private route; route execution remains separately gated.
